reading: Encompass Digital Media is a broadcast and media services company, privately held under ownership by private equity firm EagleTree Capital, that provides video content delivery, playout, and distribution services to media and entertainment industry clients rather than general-purpose enterprise colocation. Its Minnesota facility sits in Lino Lakes, at or near a site with a documented history as a satellite communications earth station complex known as the Lino Lakes Teleport, though this registry could not independently confirm the precise relationship between that historical teleport site and Encompass's current facility operations there. As a media services provider rather than a colocation or wholesale data center company, Encompass's facilities are built around broadcast signal processing, content playout, and distribution infrastructure rather than general enterprise or cloud tenant hosting, a business model distinct from the wholesale and colocation operators that make up most of this registry. The operator's own site could not be directly accessed during this research session due to a site access restriction, so facility-level technical specifications such as capacity in megawatts are recorded as not published rather than estimated.
